name: zot-speaks
description: Speak the last agent message aloud via Gradium Phonon (/tts); /tts-settings picks voice (English catalog for phonon-31m-en), a 0-100% volume dial, temperature and auto speak (off · this project · every project, cycled with the arrows: it reads the last agent message aloud when a turn ends), previews each voice as you browse, and pins favorite voices with f. Local-only: reads the Hugging Face cache, never downloads at runtime.
